strings.Main.BaseListHelp:
The central list of 1C infobases.

• To launch a base, select it and click 1C:Enterprise or Configurator in the right panel (or double-click the row).
• Groups expand/collapse with the ◂ arrow, as well as with the ←/→ keys when a group is selected.
• The ↑/↓ arrows move the selection between rows.
• ★ adds a base to Favorites (quick launch Alt+1…Alt+9); 📌 pins it at the top of the list.
• The width of any column can be changed by dragging the separator on its right edge.
• Clicking the Name or Last launch header sorts the list.
strings.Main.TagFilterHelp:
The quick tag filter panel.

• Click a tag — the base list is filtered by that tag (the selected tag is highlighted).
• You can select several tags at once — bases that have all the selected tags are shown (multi-filter).
• Clicking the selected tag again removes it from the filter.
• The Clear button (on the right) resets all selected tags.
• While filtering by tag, groups and pinned bases are temporarily hidden — a single flat list of found bases is shown.
strings.Main.CurrentSessionHelp:
The Current session block sets the client mode and bitness only for the next launch of 1C:Enterprise, without changing the saved infobase settings.

• Client mode:
    • Auto (per base settings)
    • Ordinary application (ordinary forms, /RunModeOrdinaryApplication)
    • Thick client (managed forms, /RunModeManagedApplication)
    • Thin client (managed forms)
• Bitness: Auto / 32 / 64.

The selected values apply to the next launch; the infobase settings in properties remain unchanged.

strings.Settings.General.ComConnectorTemplateToo: COM connector name template for connecting to different platform versions without manual COM re-registration. Placeholders expand from the infobase platform version: %V12% — first two digits (83, 82), %V3% — third digit (27, 5), %V4% — fourth digit (1644, 4). Example: V%V12%.ComConnector. A version part that is missing is dropped together with the separator before it: with version 8.3 the template V%V12%.COMConnector_%V3% yields V83.COMConnector. But if the infobase platform version is not set at all, or the name comes out empty, the template is not expanded — enter the full name without placeholders instead. strings.Settings.Ibases.HelpText:
Synchronization with the standard 1C base list file ibases.v8i.

• Mode: disabled / load only / export only / two-way (export first, then load).
• File: path to ibases.v8i (default %APPDATA%\1C\1CEStart\).
• Synchronization moment: on start, by interval (min) or by schedule (HH:MM).
• Import from file… adds infobases from the file into the application; Export to file… does the opposite.
• It is recommended to enable ibases.v8i backups before synchronization — they can be restored with the Restore from the latest copy button.
strings.Settings.Ibases.HelpTextLinux:
Synchronization with the standard 1C infobase list file ibases.v8i.

• Mode: disabled / import only / export only / two-way (export first, then import).
• File: path to ibases.v8i (by default ~/.1C/1cestart/, on older platform versions ~/.1cv8/1CEStart/).
• Sync moment: at startup, by interval (min) or on schedule (HH:MM).
• «Import from file…» adds infobases from the file to the application; «Export to file…» does the opposite.
• It is recommended to enable ibases.v8i backups before synchronization — they can be restored with the «Restore from the latest backup» button.

strings.CreateInfobase.HelpText:
Creating an infobase via CREATEINFOBASE.

• File-based — specify the directory where the base will be placed (1Cv8.1CD will be created).
• Client-server — specify the 1C server, the base name on the server and (optionally) the port.
• Create from template — choose a configuration from the installed templates (.cf / .dt) or specify a file manually.
• Architecture: the "(32)/(64)" suffix of the platform version sets it explicitly; without a suffix the default architecture from Settings → Platforms is used (issue #305).
• You can create an empty base or one from a template; after creation it will appear in the base list.

strings.Dbms.Title: DBMS backups
strings.Dbms.Intro: Backs up a client-server infobase with DBMS tools: PostgreSQL — pg_dump (custom format), MS SQL Server — BACKUP DATABASE … WITH COPY_ONLY via sqlcmd. For large infobases this is faster than a .dt dump and needs no exclusive access. For regular backups create a scheduled task “DBMS backup”.
strings.Dbms.CloudSection: Upload the backup to the cloud (WebDAV)
strings.Dbms.CloudHint: For example, Yandex Disk: https://webdav.yandex.ru/Backup1C (app password), Nextcloud: https://host/remote.php/dav/files/<user>/Backup1C. Empty — the backup stays local only.

strings.Bot.Title: Telegram bot commands
strings.Bot.Intro: The notification bot can accept commands: status summary, the list of scheduled tasks, running a task and a monitoring check. The bot token and chat are set in “Telegram and email notifications”. Commands are accepted only from allowed chats while the program is running.
strings.Bot.AllowedChatsHint: You can specify a chat ID or a link like t.me/c/1234567890/1234 — commands will be accepted from that topic.
strings.Bot.TokenOk: The bot is configured, notification chat: {0}. If the allowed chat list is empty, commands are accepted only from this chat.
strings.Bot.TokenMissing: The bot token is not set — specify it in “Telegram and email notifications”.
strings.Bot.SavedNoToken: Settings saved, but the bot token is not set — commands will not be accepted.
strings.Bot.Help:
Commands:
/status — summary: computer, program version, scheduled tasks
/tasks — scheduled tasks and the last run result
/run N — run task number N from the /tasks list
/alerts — check 1C servers and event logs now
/help — this help
strings.Bot.RunDisabled: Running tasks via the bot is disabled in the program settings.
strings.Shared.Title: Shared team infobase lists
strings.Shared.Intro: Subscribes to a shared ibases.v8i file (network folder or http address). The infobases of each source appear in a group named after the list and are updated automatically: new ones are added, changed ones updated, removed ones deleted from the list. Personal infobases are not affected.
strings.Shared.Interval: Sync every, min (0 — at startup only):
strings.Shared.Hint: The team administrator maintains one ibases.v8i file (for example, \\server\1C\ibases.v8i) and everyone's infobase list updates itself.
strings.Shared.Result: Added: {0}, updated: {1}, removed: {2}, skipped (already in the personal list): {3}
strings.Shared.FillAll: Fill in the name and location for every source.

strings.IbUsers.Hint: Connects via the COM connector with the infobase Designer credentials (administrative rights required). In SSL-based configurations users are kept in the Users catalog — check its records after changes made here.

strings.Jobs.Title: Infobase scheduled jobs
strings.Jobs.Hint: Connects via the COM connector with the infobase Designer credentials. Enabling and disabling jobs is written to the infobase immediately; in a client-server infobase scheduled jobs must also not be blocked in the cluster.
